results.name: Weapons - Official Terraria Wiki
results.snippet: Melee weapons Swords Swords are melee weapons that can be divided into two basic categories: shortswords and broadswords. Broadswords are swung overhead, making it easier to defeat flying and jumping enemies. Shortswords have a very limited range and attack similarly to spears, allowing stabbing in multiple directions rather than in an arc.
